title: 3D Shapes for Kids! Cube, Sphere, Cone and More
intro: Hi, friends! I'm Bloop, and welcome to Bloop's Color Lab!
Today we're meeting five shapes you can hold in your hands!
I put on my lab goggles, and I'm ready to learn something new with you.
Can you count with me? One, two, three, four, five!
Ready? Let's wiggle into the lab!

lines: Here's a clue: it looks like a box, with flat sides all around! Can you guess?
This is Cube! Can you say cube?
Look at this side. It's a square!
A cube has six flat sides, and every side is a square.
Can you draw a square in the air with your finger?
Can you guess? What else is shaped like a cube?
A gift box, and a little toy block!
One more time, nice and loud: CUBE! Great job!
Cubes can stack up tall, because their sides are flat.
Here's a clue: it's round like a ball, all the way around! Can you guess?
This is Sphere! Can you say sphere?
Look! It's round everywhere, with no corners at all.
A sphere can roll, and roll, and roll.
Can you roll your arms around like a rolling ball?
Can you guess? What else is a sphere?
A beach ball, and a juicy orange!
One more time, nice and loud: SPHERE! Great job!
Our planet Earth is shaped like a giant sphere, too!
Here's a clue: it's pointy on top and round on the bottom! Can you guess?
This is Cone! Can you say cone?
Look! The bottom is a circle, and the top is a point.
Pointy top, round bottom. That's a cone!
Can you make a pointy hat with your hands on your head?
Can you guess? What else is shaped like a cone?
An ice cream cone, and an orange traffic cone!
One more time, nice and loud: CONE! Great job!
Lay a cone on its side, and it rolls around in a circle.
Here's a clue: it looks like a can, with circles on both ends! Can you guess?
This is Cylinder! Can you say cylinder?
Look! A circle on the top, and a circle on the bottom.
A cylinder can stand up tall, or roll on its side.
Can you roll your hands over and over, like a rolling can?
Can you guess? What else is a cylinder?
A toy drum, and a cup!
One more time, nice and loud: CYLINDER! Great job!
Lots of crayons are shaped like a cylinder, with a pointy tip.
Here's a clue: it has a square bottom, and its sides meet at a point! Can you guess?
This is Pyramid! Can you say pyramid?
Look! Its sides are triangles, and they meet at the top.
A pyramid has a flat square bottom, so it sits nice and still.
Can you put your hands together over your head, like a pointy pyramid?
Can you guess? What else looks like a pyramid?
A tent, and a stack of blocks!
One more time, nice and loud: PYRAMID! Great job!
Long ago, people built giant pyramids out of stone.

recap: A cube, like a gift box.
A cone, like an ice cream cone.
And a pyramid, like a tent!
outro: Which of these shapes can you find in your toy box? Keep looking for shapes everywhere you go.
Bye, friends! See you in the lab!
